headline: Executive order keeps certain federal advisory committees running instead of letting them expire.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order continues certain federal advisory committees, which are groups that give advice to the President or federal agencies. No summary was provided, so the list of committees and how long they are extended are not stated here. Orders with this title are usually issued every two years to keep these groups from expiring.

who_it_affects.how: Committees covered by the order can keep meeting and giving advice instead of shutting down.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that rely on these committees
who_it_affects.how: Agencies can keep getting advice from the continued committees.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 29, 2025; the exact start and end dates are not given in the provided information.
